sections.Profile:
"Spain 82" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Playmatic in October 1982. Designed for up to four players, it features four flippers, two pop bumpers, five standup targets, two banks of three drop targets, five star rollovers, two kick-out holes, and a vertical up-kicker that propels the ball to an elevated tube, delivering it to the right side of the playfield.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1982
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Soccer, Sports, Original Theme, Football, Solid State, 1980s
